fields.options: Build a document number from the Segments below (drag to reorder). Watch the Live Preview update as you go. When several rules match a document, the most specific one wins (Company + Branch + each condition add specificity).

fields.description: Optional — leave blank to apply to every company.
fields.label: Company

fields.description: Optional — leave blank to apply to every branch.
fields.label: Branch

fields.description: When this rule matches a document, auto-fill its Document No. Leave off to only format the name/voucher number.
fields.label: Auto-fill Document No.

fields.description: The field the auto number is written into. Defaults to custom_document_no; pick a suggestion or type another field name if this doctype stores it differently.
fields.label: Document No. field

fields.description: What to do when a manually-typed Document No. is already used: stop with an error, or silently assign the next available number (you are alerted).
fields.label: On Duplicate Document No.
fields.options:
Throw Error
Use Next Available Number

fields.description: This rule applies only when ALL conditions match the document. Pick a field, then choose/type the value it must equal. Leave empty for a default/base rule.
fields.label: Apply only when … (conditions)

fields.description: This rule builds the VOUCHER NUMBER (name) only when ALL of these match. Leave empty for a default/base rule.
fields.label: Voucher No. Conditions

fields.description: Separate from the Voucher No. conditions above. The DOCUMENT NO. is auto-filled only when ALL of these match. Leave empty to auto-fill for every document this rule applies to.
fields.label: Auto-fill Document No. only when …

fields.description: Which date on the document to compare against the cut-over. Leave blank to use Posting/Transaction Date automatically.
fields.label: Date Field

fields.description: Optional cut-over in ONE rule: documents dated up to the date below COPY their number from the chosen field (the old ERP number); documents after it get a generated number from the Segments. Leave blank if there is no legacy data.
fields.label: Legacy numbers (before cut-over)

fields.description: Up to and including this date, copy the number from the Legacy Source Field instead of generating one.
fields.label: Copy Legacy Number Upto

fields.description: Field on the document that holds the old ERP number (e.g. custom_narration or remarks).
fields.label: Legacy Source Field

fields.description: The number is built by joining these segments (in order) with the separator. Empty segments are skipped. Include exactly one Number segment.
fields.label: Number Segments

fields.description: Where the generated number is stored on the document.
fields.label: Store Number In
